transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi, thank you so much for seeing me. Um, I hope I'm doing this right, but... I guess the main reason I came in is that I just get pulled off track a little easily? It's probably not a huge deal, and I know everyone gets distracted sometimes, but I just feel a bit bad about it. 

Like, if I get one Slack ping, or even just hear a certain song lyric, or... or if I just get a random idea for another project, suddenly I’ve completely lost the thread of what I was actually supposed to be doing. Like this dashboard I was supposed to be finishing recently, I just kept losing my place. I really want to be doing a good job and staying focused, but it just slips away. Does that make sense? I hope that's the kind of thing you were asking about.
Have you noticed these difficulties with focus and distraction mostly recently, or have they been present since childhood?

Um, well, I guess it's actually been a thing since I was pretty young. I hope it's okay to bring up stuff from that far back? 

Even in elementary school, my teachers would write little notes on my report cards. They were always really nice about it, but they'd mention that I tended to rush through my worksheets a bit, or that I'd sort of lose track of the directions they had just given us. And... I feel a little bad admitting this, because I really didn't mean to be rude, but they also said I would sometimes talk over my classmates during group work. I just got so eager to share, I think. 

And at home, my parents actually used to sit right beside me while I did my homework. If they didn't, I would just kind of wander off or start doing something else before I finished. They were really supportive about it, though! I just... I guess I've always been a little scattered like that. Is that the kind of background information you need?
Do you often find yourself struggling with constant worry about a variety of everyday matters that feels difficult to control?

Um, no, I don't really think I do. I mean, I hope I'm answering this right, but... I don't feel like I'm constantly worrying about things. 

I definitely care a lot about doing a good job, and I do feel a little guilty when I get distracted and fall behind, but it's not like an out-of-control worry about everyday stuff. I'm actually a pretty positive person most of the time! I just... I mostly just worry a little bit about disappointing people when I lose my place or forget things. 

But as for constant worry about normal everyday matters, no, I don't think so. Is that okay? I hope I'm not misunderstanding what you mean by worry.
